country_profile.name: France métropolitaine
country_profile.scope_note: Extrait métropolitain Geofabrik ; DOM/TOM exclus. Le polygone d'extraction ne constitue pas une frontière administrative officielle.

sources.generator: BC power-way subset of Geofabrik; pyosmium 4.3.2

derived_from.operation: Retain ALL ways with key power and their referenced nodes; no voltage, aerial or geographical filter applied here. country_build.py performs the unchanged LFQO filter.

coverage.meaning: Geofabrik extraction footprint, not an official national boundary; OSM coverage is non-exhaustive

filter.multiple_values: all components known positive integer volts; at least one >= 63000; preserve raw tag

border_policy: Clip to extraction footprint; same way/id may occur in adjacent countries with complementary/overlapping fragments. Merge by way/id AND segments, never drop the whole neighbouring fragment.
duplicate_policy: Highest observed OSM version, then OSM timestamp, source snapshot, source id; filter applied AFTER version selection. Missing/deleted objects in older extractions cannot be reconstructed.
